policy: This ledger maps each of the 30 official articles to source and executable regression files. 'verified' means the article's enumerated standard examples and the applicable tested contrasts/interactions are represented; it does not mean every Korean lexical item or productive morphology is covered. The engine must fail on incorrect expected surface forms, unresolved placeholders in cases claimed resolved, duplicate/missing evidence, or contradictions between lexical and rule output. Ukrainian targets are project-level approximations, never official NIKL prescriptions. Article 1 is a governing principle rather than a standalone phonological rewrite.

articles.notes: Governing principle, not a standalone phonological rewrite. Reviewed in the article-by-article audit; its operational consequence is to separate standard surface pronunciation from spelling and to preserve evidence/uncertainty. No claim of lexical completeness.

This status means finite normative-example coverage only; it does not claim productive morphological analysis or exhaustive coverage of all Korean vocabulary. Ukrainian outputs remain project approximations, not official standards.
